avis.titre: Essential Face Tonic - LOVE the Product, HATE the New Packag
avis.texte: I have used & loved this product for many years. However, the new size & packaging is horrific! I usually bought the flip top option which was 8 ounces, or if not available, the pump option which was 6.7 ounces. Both options were the same price. The flip top has been my first choice since the pump hasn't always worked well. Now, the bottle is only 4 ounces for the same, or basically, the same price! I cannot fathom why a product that is the consistency of water, as opposed to a thicker serum, & that is used twice daily is in such a small bottle? Now I will have to buy it twice as often & pay the same price as the much larger bottle. It upsets me twice a day, so thank you very much for that! I actually feel deceived & am very unhappy. Also, you have to shake the bottle to get the product out instead of just gently pouring it, which is also annoying.

avis.titre: Why did the price nearly double?
avis.texte: This product used to be amazing, now it's nearly double the price. I understand wanting to use glass bottles but c'mon now.

You changed the packaging. Reduced from 8 to 4 ounces and kept the price the same. Bring back the volume and the sprayer. Love this stuff but less of the product for an already premium price I probably won't buy again.

avis.titre: Great Product/ Packaging could be better
avis.texte: This is my FAVORITE Ursa product. I love this toner and no other has ever compared. The only negative is the packaging. The new glass bottle is an improvement but thank god the sprayer from the previous packaging works. This toner is best with a spray top (more skin coverage, less waste). I also would love to see a larger amount for refills. Ordering a glass bottle every time for 4 oz. feels environmentally icky. Hope to see a "refill" option available one day!!

avis.titre: Love the product, unhappy about shrinkflation
avis.texte: I really like this product - it has given me improved skin texture and it feels refreshing. I also dislike washing my face at night (I know, I know…) so I lean heavily on the "cleanser" attribute of the toner. My gripe, and reason for giving it four stars instead of five, is that the new packaging is half the volume of the former packaging. And the price wasn't adjusted for the four ounce reduction in the amount in the bottle. I will have to think long and hard about repurchasing.
I like the product but I'm so disappointed that using it twice daily with a cotton ball, it only lasted a few weeks. So disappointing.

I've purchased this along with other Ursa Major products religiously for years now. I love it. When I went to order my next bottle, I noticed the new packaging. I also noticed it's now only 4oz instead of 8. Super annoying considering the price for the new bottle doesn't reflect the change in quantity. Basically paying the same amount for half as much. Now I have to decide if I really need this in my routine…

avis.titre: New packaging is a huge bummer
avis.texte: I've been using this product since it first launched. I'm such a big fan. I'm all for more sustainable / eco-friendly packaging, but it's painful to lose half the product and pay almost the same price. I just have to believe there's a halfway point available to avoid such a drastic change / mark up in a product. At the very least I hope a spray top option comes back, perhaps without additional cost this time around. Will always love you though Ursa Major!

I am in love with the face wipes that Ursa Major sells, which is how I knew I was going to love the tonic as soon as I opened it. It has that same barky scent, which is so grounding and natural. A little goes a long way in my opinion, so dont go too heavy. It leaves my skin feeling rejuvenated instead of drying out my skin. I use right after cleansing, and then follow it up with a good moisturizer. My skin feels plump and healthy.
My skin feels fresh after use. I appreciate how gentle it is because i do have such sensitive skin.

avis.titre: Long-time customer, but miss the old options.
avis.texte: I've been using this for years -- I love it. And I am all for sustainability, but I miss the larger size option and the sprayer. Hoping both will be added back soon!
I hate the new bottle compared to the old one. You got a lot more product in the old one and it was way more convenient to use.

avis.titre: Why did you change the bottle?
avis.texte: No longer squeezable and the plastic cap needs to be shaken to get anything out.
Glass is heavy and breaks in the bathroom. And the price doubled. It's the most expensive tonic on the market now. Making it hard to stay loyal.

I love this tonic but the new packaging should come with a warning. The product page provides no indication that the new packaging is glass, significantly heavier, and HALF THE VOLUME of the previous bottle. For long term customers, this unannounced switch toes the boundary of being a deceptive maneuver. It was certainly an unpleasant surprise. I appreciate Ursa Major's intention to reduce plastic use; however, this lack of transparency is leaving a rather sour taste. Also, the odd little plastic flipper under the cap is problematic. When it inevitably breaks, traveling with this bottle will be impossible due to leakage. Further more, one of the main problems of a facial toner being in such a small, slick, and heavy glass bottle is that usually we are using it right after washing so hands and sink area are tending to be wet. This bottle needs to be held upside down and shaken fairly vigorously to get the toner out and I am already feeling unsafe using it. What all of this means is that I will have to start looking for an alternative toner even though I am otherwise happy with the product. This is an unforced error, Ursa Major. Please do better…

I love all the UM products I have ordered, but I remain confused about how to use them. I realize this may be sold as a freewheeling use concept, where you determine what's best for you, but I find I may be over-buying because I can't seem to figure what the product is for and what or in what order. For instance: I love the Gel Moisturizer daytime gel ( I think it's called something else now), but feel I'm shortchanging my face by not applying other products after/before/ ?? my morning cleansing routine. Also love the Mtn Glow Serum (?) which is a different name from what I purchased before, but when do I use it? Morning? After? Wrinkles? Every day? When needed? This product is expensive. I want to buy what I need and use what I need for what I need it for. Changing the names of the products is not helpful. I love your products but I really don't like being confused about what to buy and how to use them. I only have so much $ to invest in my skin. Please help.
I love this stuff. Been buying it for 5 years. But now it's almost the same price for half the amount and I just can't do it. I'll miss it and this brand.

I've been using this product a while now, and JUST recently learned it's actually a cleanser (and 3 other things), not a toner. Which is actually fanTAStic, because, I confess, I am horrible at washing my face at night (unless I'm wearing mascara). I just hate the whole getting wet and drippy thing late at night. But I can use the Essential Face Tonic with my cotton pads and take off the day's grime AND get the other benefits of it. I'm "of an age" and thought that all skincare routines were always "cleanse, tone, hydrate." But my darling daughter disabused me of that notion so now it's "cleanse (with Essential Face Tonic or the Fantastic Face Wash), serum, hydrate"!

I've repurchased this item countless times. I use it as a toner after cleansing my face in the evening. I use it in place of washing my face in the morning. This is such a game changer for the health of my skin. Cannot live without.
I have Bren using this for a few weeks and my skin is responding! Brighter and feels clean with out residue.
It makes my skin feel really refreshed and the scent is lovely. I gave some to my 18-year-old granddaughter, so we'll see what she says about it.

avis.titre: I really, really wanted to love it….
avis.texte: First off, I want to say that I love every other product from UM that I've ever purchased, and purchased many, many back-ups of them, so I'm a VERY loyal customer < 3. Having said that- I thought this face tonic was going to be this awesome/unique spray micellar water, but first thing I realized, is that you need to clean your face first (so my bad on that part), this is an EXTRA step, and then when I did spray it afterwards on my face, the woodsy scent was SO STRONG that I felt like I got smacked in the face with a pine branch and it really, really made me dread using it…. I could only use it once. The smell is SO STRONG. I won't be repurchasing, and I'm sad about that.

This is my newest addition from Ursa Major and I love how this tonic wipes on so smoothly without stripping. Sometimes I apply with cotton and other times I just splash it on. Love the fresh hydrated feel
I love the way this feels on my skin and how fresh and clean it makes my face feel.
Lovely aroma and refreshing! I do have a question - do you recommend using the Retinal after using this product?
I love it and I love the smell! It's like walking through the forest.
Love the Essential Face Tonic! So clean and fresh on my skin!

I love this product, but I am also looking for ways to cut back on my plastic consumption. It would be amazing if y'all would consider going to glass containers and have refills vs. having to purchase the plastic bottles over and over again.

I love all of your product and am a regular customer, however, I would like to return this tonic because following application, it creates redness on my skin. I tried it several times and it prevailed. Could I please return it and get a credit towards your GOLDEN RECOVERY CREAM as I am almost out..

I first tried this in the form of individual wipes at a vacation stay in Vermont. The ingredients actually are what is in this bottle . Very Nice product for my face. ..and being an all in one cleanser, toner, plus hydrating...it leaves my skin very nice for my night regimen. The Golden Recovery Cream to finish. I am very satisfied with these products.

I use this twice a day - first thing in the morning before other facial products and makeup and after cleansing at night. It's refreshing and I like the scent. Used after cleansing, it removes any residual makeup.

The toner I used for years was discontinued, and I am so happy that my search for a replacement is over. I love the smell and the feel of this tonic, and it makes my skin feel so good. I have sensitive skin that is prone to rosacea and have had no problems with this product.

I love this face tonic. It smells clean, does not strip your skin or burn and leaves my face feeling soft and ready for my moisturizer. The price point is excellent for the amount and quality of this Ursa Major Face Tonic.
Smells so good and makes my skin feel fresh and smooth every time
Love the product and the way it sprays on the face. Delightful gentle scent

avis.titre: Great at cleaning my face for PM routine
avis.texte: Effectively cleans and balances my face in preparation for the PM routine. Smells very nice, it does not dry the skin, and leaves a refreshing sensation on my face and neck.
I have tried other tonics that cost less and work in a pinch but Ursa Major's is my favorite! Light weight, not over drying and leaves your skin feeling clean and refreshed. Highly recommend!
I like using this tonic after I shave.. It makes my skin feel soft and not dried out..
I love the way this product gently cleanses my skin without stripping every morning. And am especially grateful for the individually wrapped packets I use when traveling - especially by air.
The scent of the tonic is amazing. I put it on at the end of the day and the scent makes me feel so relaxed and happy. Makes my skin feel soft.
I have sensitive, mature skin and was apprehensive about trying a new face wash. But this smells lovely, doesn't burn or irritate my skin at all! What a thrilling discovery!
Perfect face tonic for my normal 55 year old skin. I love it. It cleans and doesn't dry.
What a terrific product. Makes my face feel refreshed. Highly recommend!

The tonic itself is good & does what it is intended to do, the spray is awful, it gets stuck & sprays very inconsistently, you are charged more for the spray in the form of receiving less product to pay for it, terrible!
Similar to a much more expensive brand. Feels great. Smells great!
It seems to balance my skin so not so dry. Feels nice and clean.
Just the most refreshing first step in my skin routine. The scent is subtle and clean. For me it helps with absorption of the UM serum.
I discovered this tonic first as the cleansing wipe which I started using for travel and for stashing in my hiking gear for a post-hike refresh. Liked it so much that I also ordered the bottle.

This is the best toner I have ever used. I love how it removes all the last vestiges of dirt and makeup from my face, neck, and decolletage. I even love the fresh smell. I consistently get compliments on how amazing my skin looks. During my last dermatological visit, my doctor actually said to keep doing whatever I was doing (which included my shift to Ursa Major products), as my skin was looking YOUNGER than when she saw me a couple of years ago!

I am a bit addicted to a toner or tonic, but most leave my skin a bit taut and dry. Essential Face Tonic has a light refreshing scent and leaves my skin feeling nourished & clean. My skin can be a bit sensitive, but I have not had any reaction to the Tonic and use it both AM & PM.
Does exactly what it claims to do!! I have sensitive skin and this toner caused zero irritation or other issues.
I love the tonic. I feel like it gives me a better complexion after I wipe it on filling my cleanser great smell, and I can really feel the effect as soon as it touches my skin.

I like the way my skin felt after I used it. And the fact that I can leave it on is also nice. It's different being able to miss it on your face or on to cotton ground, but I really do like it so I ordered another bottle.

I'm so glad I took the Ursa Major plunge.. I came across Ursa Major a long time ago but had sufficient self-care products at the time. And then one day, I received a promotional emal with a nifty discount and decided to try out some of these wonderul products... I definitely think they live up to their "image." This tonic /toner leaves our skin looking **squeaky clean* and of course always we moisturize after..... If my boyfriend notices a difference and enjoys it I'm sure others will too.... He's not really into "pampering" himself and I'm pretty sure this is the first time in his life he began using toner and he likes it!!! I like it too :)

avis.titre: Obsessed. Great for men's skin too!
avis.texte: Very impressed. The scent is amazing, very refreshing and easy to apply and leave on. Love it!

I do love this product in the mornings. I was my face at night and use this in the AM just to prep for the day. It's great and I'm SO glad it exists. I'm knocking a star off because this packaging is ugly and cheap looking. For something I use daily, I'd like to leave it sitting out on my vanity but this big white plastic bottle is ugly. I plan to transfer it to a nice glass bottle instead and toss the bottle in the recycling. (But then I have likely created a single-use plastic scenario with this Ursa Major bottle, so that's not ideal). So yeah-- amazing product-- big fan. But I wish it was in a better bottle for both aesthetic and environmental reasons.

I have been a fan of the Essential Face Wipes for travel and was happy to realize the tonic is the same stuff. I really like that the tonic (as well as the wipes) can be "one and done." For times when for whatever reason I can't do (or don't feel like doing) a complete face wash-dry-serum-cream routine, I can still feel that I am taking care of my skin.

Since I started using this toner my serum and face cream go on top better and the additional layers are not as sticky and seem to sink in better. I think I'll eventually try out the rest of this brand to see if everything else is as good.
I like this product a lot and so does my skin. It gets the daily grime off. Recommend.
In one week of use, my pores are visibly smaller. I need a moisturizer after using it because I have dry skin and live in a desert climate.
I'm so glad I tried the Face Tonic. It makes my skin feel so good and clean but not stripped. I love the smell.
I do really like the essential face tonic. I use it after I wash my face, makes me feel as if I'm getting extra nutrients and cleanse before I put on my moisturizer.
I use it day and night after the fantastic wash and before lotion. It evened out my skin tone and shrunk my pores .

I love this tonic! I use it in the morning to freshen up my skin before my early morning workouts and anytime I need a little extra exfoliation. This product is not drying at all and feels very nourishing.
This product is awesome! Sometimes when I use a toner after washing my face I still feel like I have to wipe clean again. Not this! Felt clean and fresh !
I really enjoy using this face tonic! It is is so refreshing.
Tonic was too astringent for my aged skin. My daughter loves it so I gifted it to her.
I love this product. The smell is so perfect, and it actually works. That's a rare combination! Thank you.
Perfact add to my Ursa skincare routine. Just returned from a conference and EVERYONE asked how my skin looked to fantastic.

I have been using this toner for three months now and it has greatly reduced the red nose and cheeks I've had all my adult life from Rosecea. I am so amazed how great my skin looks and feels. I use the Golden Hour Face Cream after the toner every day and all I can say is this combination has made the skin on my face very, very happy! No more, red cheeks, nose and breakouts and lines are greatly softened. I buy the toner and face cream two at a time so I always have them. Give this product a try. You won't be sorry.
I love this so much - I purchased the spray bottle - only thing I'd change is the top - I think it could come out a bit easier from the nozzle. Other than that this is perfection!

I have sensitive skin and try not to "wash" my face every day. I've been doing a gentle cleanse with micellar water and then using this toner on a cotton pad immediately after. Skin looks and feels fresh and revitalized instantly. The scent is earthy, it does not irritate or cause redness, and I love that it has aloe, antioxidants and hyaluronic acid. This is my new favorite first step in the morning after cleansing. I follow with my normal vitamin C and moisturizers and it layers well. I will be repurchasing.

avis.titre: I forgot that this is what toner can do
avis.texte: I used to use toner pretty religiously and for some reason, in my mid or late twenties, I stopped. Maybe I thought I was drying out my skin. Since my teenage years, I've had incredibly oily skin and I thought that by trying to mattify it constantly, I was actually making my skin produce more oil and that I should actually just focus on moisturizing my skin instead of stripping it of its oils. By my thirties, I still had the same oily skin, but I also had congested pores and perpetual white heads in the crevices around and under my nose. My skin was often easily inflamed – redness brought on by hot showers, exercise, and more. I bought this face tonic during Ursa Major's Black Friday sale (it's normally far pricier than any other toner I've used). I've been using it for about two months and my skin feels less irritated/congested and my whiteheads are mostly not an issue anymore. It feels like it's a very gentle exfoliation – one I can use multiple times a day. I wear a mask for 8 hours a day at work and to prevent breakouts, I swipe this onto my face during my one break and it's helped control acne formation. I use this product with the Vitamin C serum and the Golden Hour Recovery cream.
I assume this is what goes in the face wipes; so for me its more convenient as a spray.

I had bought this because I really wanted an exfoliation of some sort and stumbled across this. I enjoy the fact that you can spray and walk away. I only use this a few times a week after I get out of the shower however I am noticing a difference for the better in my skin.
After using toner for a week twice per day, no improvements noticed or negative reactions.
I use this during the day to brighten up my skin, it works wonderfully.

I had already been using this tonic in the non-spray bottle and really love it. It's absolutely refreshing and a great way to do a simple face cleansing when I feel tired at the end of the day. That said, I found that I was often drenching the bamboo cotton pads I use to wipe my face with and just making one spot overly wet. I decided to buy the spray bottle so that I could have a more even distribution on the pad and that is working out great. I've decided to keep doing that and just use the non-spray bottle as my refill bottle since the entire bottle is recyclable. The sprayer was a little glitchy at first but repeated use seems to have straightened that problem out.

avis.titre: Gentle, maybe too gentle for me
avis.texte: I was hoping it'd have a little more of an exfoliating effect, but it would probably be good for someone with sensitive skin.

I am a sole believer in this face care line!!! After using the Fantastic Face Wash, my second step is using the face tonic, followed with their Vitamin C serum and then the Golden Hour Recovery Cream. I have found this skin care to be very clean and I have noticed a great improvement reducing my age spots and has improved the softness and texture of my skin. VERY PLEASED with this skincare line!!! I suggest you give it a try….
I do a thorough face wash routine at night, but in the morning, I prefer just to splash this on for a mild cleaning with a smell that wakes me up. Feels clean without stripping moisture.

Because I tend to be oily even at this stage of life (mid-60's) I like the freshness and extra clean of a tonic. This one is perfect - deeper clean that using the wash only but very gentle. It is now part of my evening regimen every day.
I use this every morning and it keeps me clean, clear, and bright.
Absolutely a wonderful toner! I love the feeling it leaves on your skin, fresh and clean and hydrated. Love it!
This is the best face tonic I have ever used. The tonic does not trigger redness (Rosacea) and it is not drying out my skin. And, it smells fantastic. Thank you.
This is the best cleanser that I have ever used. I stopped using it for a while and soon recognized how much this cleanser does for my skin. LOVE IT!
I'm really impressed with this tonic, it surpassed my expectations. I noticed a difference the first time I used it. I woke up with noticeably calmer skin after one night.
I recently transitioned to the Ursa Major skin care line after trying out the Golden Hour Recovery Cream - after many years with my former products, I am very happy with this new line.
Hydrating and Refreshing! Love ❤️️ the entire product line!
Instead of using this after my morning face wash, I save it for nighttime. Soaking a cotton pad, it removes the garden dirt, daytime dust, and gives my skin a clean palate for overnight restoration.
This product is a great base, a wonderful refresher or bedtime finisher. It smells clean and feels good.
I was hesitant because of the price, but it's 100% worth it. I can feel an immediate difference in my skin.
I like this stuff. Wish it smelled a little bit better but it works and my skin feels refreshed.
a great product thus far! I like very much the way it feels on my face and cleanses at the same time.
I love spraying this on my face after I shower. It's immediately hydrating!

I have loved all the products I have gotten from UM but this is definitely one of my faves! My face feels clean and refreshed after using, and it doesn't irritate my eyes. Love using it at night to take off my makeup and then use the Mountain Glow Serum. Also, UM has some of the best customer service there is! I didn't get my free samples in my last order and they popped them in the mail PRONTO! It wasn't a big deal that I didn't receive them, but I like that a company stands behind what they say and are promoting. I will continue to try their products!
I am loving this tonic! I added it to my nightly regimen two weeks ago and my pores are smaller, my skin feels brighter and I'm receiving compliments from my friends on how great my skin looks.
This is the best toner/tonic I've tried. It feels cooling and active. My skin feels refreshed after I use it.
